notes:
Pages opened: Commagene and Antiochus IV of Commagene (the budget is 1-2). Both pages are thin on borders; no page gives an area, so the infobox area check could not be made (Cliopatria 9.6-9.8 k km2 against 'roughly Adıyaman and northern Antep').

Cliopatria row ends in 77 but both pages date the end to 72; the row has no shape for 23-42 (annexation of 17 to restoration of 38-41) which fits the pages loosely (17..38).

Not settled: (1) the pages give no date for Caligula's deposition of Antiochus IV (between 38 and 41), so the kingdom is held through 42 and no loss is recorded; (2) 61: 'He gained parts of Armenia' for serving under Corbulo - no land named, not drawn; (3) the Armenian suzerainty of Mithridates Callinicus is 'thought' and undated; (4) Zeugma was 'ruled for a time by Commagene' (Strabo: Pompey assigned it) without a date, and lies south of the Cliopatria shape; (5) the Cilician strip's boundaries are not given and the gazetteer's 'Cilicia' is the plain: the gazetteer agent should add 'Cilicia Trachea'.

For the roman-empire dossier (eu-04): it records Commagene as a client from 27 BC to 72 without the annexation of 17 and the restoration of 38; this dossier carries the loss in 17 and the gain in 38 with counterpart roman-empire.

[fix me-06-b, 2026-10-19] Reviewer verdict fail, repaired. (1) The Cliopatria outline is wrong in every keyframe (verdict wrong for _-63, _43, _68): only 9 of its 36 cells are in Adiyaman, 12 are in Elazig and 8 in Malatya, the capital lies south of its box, and 17 cells overlap kingdom-of-cappadocia's -64 shape. Every region now uses Adiyaman + a 15 km circle at Samosata (the Samosata cell is in Sanliurfa province in the grid, not Adiyaman) + the part of Gaziantep north of 37.1N (the page: 'roughly Adiyaman and northern Antep'): 38 cells, about 9.7 k km2. For me-05: Cappadocia's -63 loss to Commagene (/ledger/13) rests on the misplaced shape; the corrected Commagene does not touch the Cappadocia -64 outline. (2) The Cilician strip is a polygon for the coastal Taurus between Coracesium (Alanya) and the Lamos river, south of 37.0N (62 cells), at the reviewer's suggestion; the Cilicia page does not name which part Antiochus IV got and does not mention the Lamos as a boundary, so the polygon is a reading, confidence 2. Gazetteer name still needed: Cilicia Trachea. (3) Roman client chain added: roman-republic -64 (Pompey's ally; the page also says 'independent from the Romans', so it is a reading), roman-empire -27 to 16 (mirrors eu-04 /ledger/4), 38-39 and 41-71 (to 72, eu-04 /54). For eu-04: its tint is unbroken -27 to 72 although the kingdom was a province 17-38. (4) The Caligula deposition is bridged to 40 (confidence 1) and the restoration is 41 (confidence 3; both pages date it), keyframes _38 (38-39) and _41 (41-42). The earlier notes said the pages give no date for the restoration; that was wrong, both give 41. (5) Samosata coordinates now 37.58N 38.48E (Samsat page). (6) Thin items, pages re-opened: the Roman-Parthian War of 58-63 page has no recipient or district for the 'outlying western parts of Armenia' (so the 61 gain stays undrawn); Zeugma page says nothing of Commagene; Tigranes page (opened under Adiabene) has no sentence on Commagene, so the Armenian suzerainty of Mithridates Callinicus stays undated and undrawn. Disagreement with the reviewer: none.
Flag for eu-03: Cliopatria's Roman Republic shape of -63 holds 24 of the 38 corrected Commagene cells (13 of Adiyaman and 11 of northern Gaziantep), so that outline and this kingdom claim the same land from -63; the strip polygon is the generous reading (62 cells, about 15.7 k km2, larger than the kingdom's 38 cells), kept at the reviewer's 37.0N limit.
